env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A function literal started with go inside a group body ejects to Go that
# parses, builds and prints what the native run prints. The ejected module
# builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^hi/ann$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/groupgofunc

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync/atomic"
)

type gU struct{ gN string }

var out atomic.Value

func (u *gU) gSend(s string) { out.Store(s + "/" + u.gN) }

func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	var o *gU? = &gU{gN: "ann"}
	go group (ctx) {
		ocopy := o
		go func() {
			if ocopy != nil {
				ocopy.gSend("hi")
			}
		}()
		o = nil
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(out.Load())
}
